The '''2026 Eastleigh Borough Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect 14 of 39 members of [[Eastleigh Borough Council]] in [[Hampshire]], [[England]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Borough elections and results {{!}} Eastleigh Borough Council|url=https://www.eastleigh.gov.uk/council/elections-and-voting/elections/borough-council-elections|website=www.eastleigh.gov.uk|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en}}</ref> Members of the [[Eastleigh]] town council will also be elected.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Two councils to merge as fresh local elections set for 2026|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/news/25634864.boyatt-wood-eastleigh-town-councils-merge-2026/|website=Daily Echo|date=2025-11-19|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en}}</ref>

==Background==
In [[2024 Eastleigh Borough Council election|2024]], the [[Liberal Democrats (UK)|Liberal Democrats]] retained control of the council.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Full list of results for Eastleigh Borough Council elections|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/news/24295835.eastleigh-borough-council-elections-2024-list-results/|website=Daily Echo|date=2024-05-02|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en}}</ref>

Changes 2024–2026:
*January 2025: [[Liz Jarvis]] (Liberal Democrats) resigns – by-election held March 2025<ref>{{cite news |last1=Marshall |first1=Ross |title=Eastleigh MP Liz Jarvis steps down as councillor |url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/news/24891688.liz-jarvis-steps-councillor-eastleigh/ |access-date=16 February 2026 |work=Daily Echo |date=28 January 2025 |language=en}}</ref>
*March 2025: Prad Bains (Liberal Democrats) wins by-election<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Hamble and Netley Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/19162/#2025-03-06 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=16 February 2026}}</ref>
*April 2025: 
**Bhavin Dedhia (Liberal Democrats) resigns – by-election held May 2025<ref>{{cite news |last1=Slominski |first1=Stephen |title=Another by-election called in Eastleigh Central as councillor steps down |url=https://www.eastleighnews.co.uk/2025/04/another-by-election-called-in-eastleigh-central-as-councillor-steps-down/ |access-date=16 February 2026 |work=Eastleigh News |date=2 April 2025}}</ref>
**Jane Welsh (Liberal Democrats) dies – by-election held May 2025<ref>{{cite news |last1=Slominski |first1=Stephen |title=Jane Welsh, long-serving Hedge End councillor and former mayor, has died |url=https://www.eastleighnews.co.uk/2025/03/jane-welsh-long-serving-hedge-end-councillor-and-former-mayor-has-died/ |access-date=16 February 2026 |work=Eastleigh News |date=26 March 2025}}</ref>
*May 2025: 
**Mark Harding (Liberal Democrats) wins by-election<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Eastleigh Central Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/19158/#2025-05-08 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=16 February 2026}}</ref>
**John Shepherd (Liberal Democrats) wins by-election<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Hedge End South Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/19164/#2025-05-22 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=16 February 2026}}</ref>
